Both orders were accepted (day orders, pending fill). Here's the audit trail for today's run (2026-09-01):

**Existing positions reviewed (no action needed):**
- **AVGO, DELL, HPE** calendars are already open (all sold 9/4 front, bought 10/2 back). Checked front expiries: all are 3 trading days out (9/4), which is outside the "within 2 days" roll trigger. Checked front vs. back IV on each — none show the crush-captured pattern (front IV is still well above back IV: AVGO 1.17 vs 0.49, DELL 1.54 vs 0.73, HPE 1.62 vs 0.74), so earnings hasn't printed/crushed yet on any of them. No rolls triggered today.
- No open orders were sitting stale from earlier in the day.

**New candidates from today's scan:**
- **DELL, AVGO** — flagged as Tier A candidates, but calendars are already open on both tickers. Per the no-duplicate rule, skipped new entries here even though the scan re-flagged them.
- **PANW** — new name, no existing position. Pulled the exact 9/4 360C and 10/2 360C contracts. Front OI 124 (fine), back OI 14 (thin but above the 10-contract floor), spreads reasonably tight (~6.5%/5.8%). Net mid debit $9.105. Sized 3 contracts (~$2,732 debit, 2.8% of $97,921 equity — within the 2.5-3% band) and placed a day limit at $9.30 (~2% above mid, aggressive side per the fill-discipline rule).
- **NTAP** — new name, no existing position. Pulled the 9/18 185C and 10/16 185C contracts. OI comfortable on both legs (226 / 41). Back-leg spread was wider (~14.7%) than ideal, but OI cleared the bar and this width is in line with what was already tolerated on the existing HPE calendar, so proceeded rather than skip. Net mid debit $2.965. Sized 9 contracts (~$2,669 debit, 2.7% of equity) and placed a day limit at $3.05 (~3% above mid).

**Not traded:**
- No Tier B names were in today's candidate list, so nothing to flag-and-ignore there.

Both new orders are resting as day limits near live mid, sized within the 2.5-3% debit cap, bringing total concurrent calendars to 5 (AVGO, DELL, HPE, PANW, NTAP) — within the 6-8 position ceiling. Will check fills and re-evaluate rolls on the 9/4-expiring fronts next session, since that's within the 2-day roll window at that point.
